headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty wrapped up a positive week led by rally in Trent and Reliance

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Sensex and Nifty recorded a 2% weekly rise, recovering from earlier sharp losses during the week.
Buying in heavyweights like Reliance and strong foreign inflows provided support during trading sessions.
Trent led the market rally as Nifty Smallcap 100 outperformed with a 4% jump in the weekly wrap.
IT and Pharma sector stocks helped lift the benchmark indices despite midcaps sliding.
whatHappening: Indian stock market is closed today, Sunday, 1 November 2026, and will resume trading on Monday, 2 November.
In recent sessions, markets rallied over 900 points on Sensex and 1% on Nifty following strong buying.
Crude oil prices fluctuated above $116 while investors kept a close watch on US Fed policy decisions.
Analysts and traders are looking ahead to the Nov 2-6 week for a potential Diwali rally.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 2 November. Over the past week, Sensex and Nifty gained 2% supported by buying in Reliance and a strong rally led by Trent. Investors are now looking forward to the upcoming week's trading session for further signals.
